reclassification_note: Driver gate killed at (b) as PIPELINE PHANTOM (odd/even folds 0.000%/0.000%). Reclassified INCONCLUSIVE per the sweep-1 BLS-only precedent (cf. TIC 41083982, TIC 150066703): the post-gate persistence re-derivation reproduces the in-sweep stamp exactly and shows a decisively non-zero mean depth (+0.522% +/- 0.064%, 8.1 sigma) that no convicted phantom in either sweep had (mirages averaged +0.03..0.07%). The signal is not a constant-depth transit (chi2 p ~ 8e-22) and not a fold-visible eclipse; most consistent with incoherent stellar variability near the BLS period on a spotted M dwarf. Not a planet; not nothing.
